opening.argument: The title identifies a purported Microsoft technical-support scam caller, and the description says the callers contacted the uploader and that the interaction was recorded. The visible phone use fits that account, although the sampled frame cannot establish what the caller said or requested. This is a presentation of a recorded interaction, not an offer from the uploader to viewers. Nothing in the described material asks the audience for payment, private information, investment participation, or any other action.
